item.text:
Order utility module: totals item line prices, applies `SAVE10`/`SAVE20`, calculates an average, and formats an order summary.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`, so the final iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (undefined) and throws on any non-empty list. Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides the total order cost by item count, so it is not an average per-item price when quantities exceed 1; it should divide by total quantity if that’s intended.
- `averageItemPrice([])` returns `NaN` (or errors first because of `calcTotal`); empty orders need defined handling.
